author: KadirGarib
body:
Straightened, I was pvping legit, people thought I had forcefield when I did not. The whole "fly-hacking" thing is bs on its own. I was on my team, when the incident happened, not on the opposing team while pvping. Idk how I was "flying", but in the end, the staff can do what they want. Avicus is decreasing in popularity, anyways. When I shared an account with my friend on McZone, things were a lot more brighter in a way.

I'd like to see video evidence, as it was claimed.

Why did you say "Denied" at the end. I wasn't even appealing again, lol. I was asking for a response. I don't care if you'll miss me or not (obvious sarcasm), I have much better things to do, than to put up with a rant against you, and staff in general.

I regret wasting my time here anyways. It's just a complete copy of oc.tc anyways, from the forum layout, gamemodes, tags, teams, scrimmages, etc. All this comes from oc.tc. There's no minigame on here that has been brought up by Avicus on its own. Survival Games, TDM, are all classics. CTW, DTM, etc. are from oc.tc.

People know this is frankly, just a copy. Nothing stands out, as a matter of fact about 70% of the entire server is a copy, builds on the other hand aren't.

Likewise, I apologize for coming out rude in a way @Straightened, @Lord_Draksis. I'll just be back to see a response, and that'll be the end of me.

(This isn't an appeal, it's probably just me being a d**k to you again, and sorry for the spam)

Thanks.
